reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: active callers in src/app/actions.ts:60 and src/app/kiosk/page.tsx:34, plus GRANT in migration 20260317000001. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions configured; kiosk entry is anon/untrusted. Gate 3: supabase/migrations/ is explicitly in-scope; no exclusion applies. Code confirmed at migration line 42-44: query reads all-time last record with no date filter (ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1), causing cross-day state carryover — if a user's last record is 'in' from a prior day, the next day's first tap inserts 'out', directly violating first_record(u,d).type == 'in'. No SELECT FOR UPDATE also allows race condition on simultaneous NFC taps. An attacker (or any user whose last record crosses midnight) can trigger this via the anon kiosk NFC tap entry point by punching in on a new day after an unclosed prior session, causing the first daily record to be inserted as 'out', corrupting session-time calculations in getOverallStats and getUserAttendanceStats.
